name: words-plain
source:
Get-Item First, Second, Third
Write-Host sentinel

name: words-parameter
source:
Get-Item First, Second, Third -Verbose
Write-Host sentinel

name: words-redirect
source:
Get-Item First, Second, Third >out.txt
Write-Host sentinel

name: words-block
words-blockBody
source:
Get-Item First, Second, Third{ Write-Host inside }
Write-Host sentinel

name: mixedWord-blockBody
source:
Get-Item First, $second, "Third", 4{ Write-Host inside }
Write-Host sentinel

name: mixedExpression-blockBody
source:
Get-Item $first, Second, "Third", 4{ Write-Host inside }
Write-Host sentinel

name: mixedQuote-blockBody
source:
Get-Item "First", Second, $third{ Write-Host inside }
Write-Host sentinel

name: parenthesized-blockBody
source:
Get-Item ($first), Second, (1 + 2){ Write-Host inside }
Write-Host sentinel

name: nested-blockBody
source:
Get-Item First, ($second, $third), @(1, 2){ Write-Host inside }
Write-Host sentinel
